rows: Shut down the unit completely and coordinate with the Operations Department to implement the required precautions stated in the work order for the gas air heater of Unit No. (2), following the safety instructions for isolating the air heater.
Make sure the air heater temperature has reached the suitable temperature to start work, 60°C.

The gas air heater is chemically washed before starting work, with a chemical solution at a temperature suitable for the air heater temperature, to avoid thermal stresses on the air heater metal during washing.

Open the inspection door at the top of the air heater below the stack, then enter the air heater above the cold-zone basket trays, and empty the trays of one sector of the sheet-metal strips to allow inspection of both ends of the sector.
Inspect the expansion joints for corrosion inside the air heater parts in this area.
Erect a scaffold below the hot sheet metal inside the air heater to inspect the air heater body and the expansion joints.
Inspect the clearances of the air heater and the flexible connections and make sure they are fit for service.

On inspection, corrosion was found starting in the following places:
 Cold side 
 radial seal sector 
, consisting of two sectors and a middle part around the shaft; the corrosion is at the ends, the middle area and the other side of the sector, and the thickness has started to fall below 10 mm, which indicates that it cannot continue in service for another 6 months, so it must be replaced with a new one.

The 
 radial seal sector 
 was replaced completely.

When dismantling the side parts 
 (Seal air frame)
, responsible for 
 (Axial seal)
, the following is done:
 - Replace 
 The axial seal 
 jacket
 - 
 Adjust the axial clearances from both sides
 - 
 The tensioners and the expansion joints of the air heater were changed after completing the above work.

Parts of the
 Cold 
 side cover grates 
 were manufactured and designed under the supervision of the boiler maintenance department in the station workshops.
Expansion joints were installed for the gas passage below the gas air heater instead of the damaged parts.

After completing the air heater work and adjusting the permitted clearance values, a run test of the gas air heater was carried out to make sure of the normal operating conditions of the air heater before putting it into actual service.

Introduction
Since several years have passed since the replacement and renewal of the unit, the boiler maintenance department carries out periodic rounds on the gas air heater at each periodic maintenance, every 6 months; inspection showed the start of damage and corrosion in different places of the air heater and the insulation places (the upper separator between the air and gas paths).
Replacement of radial seal sector and axial sealing jacket for air pre-heater
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, accepted by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and approved by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.
Safety Precautions
Isolate the equipment on which maintenance is to be carried out.
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; the maintenance team must hold occupational safety and health category cards.
Record the names of the workers on the work order and their occupational safety and health categories.
Define the work area of the gas air heater and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out.
Wear the industrial safety and protection tools required for the workers while carrying out the work, such as helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete set of open-end wrenches, complete set of ring wrenches, and complete set of sockets.
Set of Allen keys, set of screwdrivers, ratchets and hammers of different sizes.
